**Truthammer — 3 October 2026**
**Inner peace, outer stench**

On his turn, Dain sits down in his Stinking Cloud and meditates inside Leaky Tent. A bold choice of meditation incense, after the beast fled the smell.

Dain remains last recorded at 28 HP; no end to his concentration or new damage is reported. The wider battle outcome remains unreported.
